name: review-workflow-codex
description: Local-first, evidence-grounded review workflow for Codex

interface.shortDescription: Turn local PDFs and drafts into traceable reviews.
interface.longDescription: A resumable Phase 0–7 workflow for narrative, critical, and technical reviews, with reciprocal scoping, local extraction, claim-level evidence, citation audits, and migration-ready artifacts.
defaultPrompt: Start a technical review from my local PDFs and draft.
Resume my review from its saved workspace state.
Audit my review's claims and citations against local sources.
